title: Technical AI Governance (TAIG) DPhil Studentships
institution: Oxford Martin AI Governance Initiative (AIGI), University of Oxford
about: Fully funded Oxford DPhil studentships in technical AI governance for October 2027 entry, with dedicated compute funding. Direct-route applications, including references, are due 2 December 2026 (midday UK); the AIMS-integrated route closes 27 January 2027.
requirements: Track I (Direct DPhil Route): complete application including references by 12:00 midday UK time, 2 December 2026, and inform the Senior Programmes Manager by email by 3 December 2026
Track II (AIMS-integrated route): deadline 12:00 midday UK time, 27 January 2027, reference AIMS-AIGI-2027
Possible second round if places remain: 2 March 2027
